% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
% Hirzebruch surface F2 fan diagram
% Generated from canonical.yaml (Pasted image 20220625182506)
% 4 rays: (1,0), (0,1), (-1,2), (0,-1)
% 4 cones: σ1, σ2, σ3, σ4
% Dashed quadrilateral connecting ray endpoints
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1.2]

% --- Lattice grid ---
% Integer lattice points from -2 to 2 in both directions
\foreach \x in {-2,-1,0,1,2} {
  \foreach \y in {-2,-1,0,1,2} {
    \fill[black!40] (\x,\y) circle (1.2pt);
  }
}

% --- Ray endpoints ---
\coordinate (v1) at (2,0);    % (1,0) scaled by 2
\coordinate (v2) at (0,2);    % (0,1) scaled by 2
\coordinate (v3) at (-2,4);   % (-1,2) scaled by 2
\coordinate (v4) at (0,-2);   % (0,-1) scaled by 2

% --- Rays from origin to endpoints ---
\draw[thick] (0,0) -- (v1);
\draw[thick] (0,0) -- (v2);
\draw[thick] (0,0) -- (v3);
\draw[thick] (0,0) -- (v4);

% --- Dashed quadrilateral connecting ray endpoints ---
\draw[dashed, thick] (v1) -- (v2) -- (v3) -- (v4) -- cycle;

% --- Ray labels ---
\node[anchor=north east, inner sep=2pt] at (2,0) {$(1,0)$};
\node[anchor=south east, inner sep=2pt] at (0,2) {$(0,1)$};
\node[anchor=south, inner sep=2pt] at (-2,4) {$(-1,2)$};
\node[anchor=north west, inner sep=2pt] at (0,-2) {$(0,-1)$};

% --- Cone labels ---
\node at (0.7,0.7) {$\sigma_1$};
\node at (-0.5,1.4) {$\sigma_2$};
\node at (-0.8,-0.6) {$\sigma_3$};
\node at (0.7,-0.6) {$\sigma_4$};

% --- Origin dot ---
\fill[black] (0,0) circle (2pt);
\node[anchor=north east, inner sep=1pt] at (0,0) {$0$};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
